name: wiener-abfahrten
description: Alexa Skill: Echtzeit-Abfahrten der Wiener Linien

scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cd lambda && zip -qr ../dist/lambda.zip . -x 'node_modules/*' '.DS_Store'
scripts.package:aws: rm -rf dist/aws && mkdir -p dist/aws && cp -R lambda/index.js lambda/lib lambda/data lambda/package.json lambda/package-lock.json dist/aws/ && npm --prefix dist/aws ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && cd dist/aws && zip -qr ../lambda-aws.zip . -x '.DS_Store' && cd .. && rm -rf aws
